render.description: Optional top-down grid renderer and live HUD (Phase 6). raylib only -- vcpkg has no raylib/Dear ImGui bridge (rlImGui), and hand-writing that backend glue was judged too high-risk to debug blind in a headless environment; live graphs and tunable parameters are drawn with raylib's own primitives and keyboard input instead.

persistence.description: Save/load and JSON-driven config for species and world parameters (Phase 8)
